## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON confirmed; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals leading (Materials, Industrials, Financials); Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers in Technology) and major-cap divergences warrant caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead with CRH (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +13.36%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong with CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND and ETN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND; Financials strong with JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND and broad financial participation.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging with XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) TREND EXHAUSTION and CVX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND; Communication weak despite pockets of strength: META (1W: +9.64% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY and GOOGL (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND show divergence; Healthcare soft/monitor with mixed internals.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -16.68% | 1M: -20.08%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -13.74% | 1M: -15.53%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.70% | 1M: +20.46%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.64% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND — watch major-cap divergences (AAPL, META, V, MA showing RECOVERY) as a tactical read.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is positive but internally mixed with Narrow leadership in semiconductors; NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND, but large-cap software names CRM (1W: -11.65% | 1M: -14.81%) BELOW TREND and NOW (1W: -18.63% | 1M: -28.22%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth shows rotation into semis and chip equipment rather than broad software strength.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive with JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector participation; GS sentiment positive and banks/financial cyclicals showing momentum. This underpins the RISK-ON call and supports cyclical exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND with bullish sentiment (UNH +70) while LLY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY and several names show idiosyncratic headlines; overall sector constructive but watch single-name headline risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/financial exposure (JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND) and high-conviction semiconductors (INTC, LRCX, AVGO ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to stretched software names showing BELOW TREND (CRM, NOW, INTU). Style: mixed—cyclical/value tilt within a growth-led narrow tech leadership; monitor the major-cap divergences before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: UNH (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND on upbeat Medicare rate news; INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation; NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND for AI demand flow. BEARISH: PSX (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) BELOW TREND on derivatives loss headlines, TSLA (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -14.44%) BELOW TREND amid negative street commentary, IBM (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) BELOW TREND after downgrades.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials and Industrials (1W leaders) where momentum is broadening; Financials for rate-sensitive cyclicals. BEARISH: Energy and Communication—Energy headlines create idiosyncratic headline risk and Communication shows mixed internals despite a few strong names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +6.34% | 1M: +1.40%) — watch continuation above recent 1W highs for follow-through; AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) — monitor sustained above the 1M gain band as breakout confirmation; AAPL (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -0.13%) — hold of the 1W lift (RECOVERY) to confirm trend change; JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) — track for breakout continuation above recent resistance to confirm financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+70): UnitedHealth Medicare rate tailwind; price confirming ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +6.69%) — sentiment confirmed. XOM (+60): Guyana oil find headline; price showing TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.61%) — sentiment diverging, watch volume. AVGO (+55): Catalyst headline with AAPL tie; price confirming ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.12% | 1M: +9.01%) — accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PSX (-60): $900M derivatives loss headline; price BELOW TREND (1W: -9.62% | 1M: -6.05%) — sentiment confirmed and high risk. TSLA (-55): negative note; price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -14.44%) — confirm downside vulnerability. IBM (-50): PT cuts ahead of earnings; price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.01% | 1M: -7.28%) — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a mixed style tilt (cyclical/value participation alongside concentrated semiconductor strength). AMZN (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +23.82% | 1M: +30.01%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +8.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (several large names in RECOVERY while many software names remain BELOW TREND) and headline-driven energy names (PSX) require active monitoring.
